# Charter

- C1 [text](sources/charter.md) The show follows the keeper of the tide bell on a small harbour island.
- C2 [text](sources/charter.md) Each episode is one tide, from low water to the next low water.
- C3 [text](sources/charter.md) The bell rings only when the sea road floods.
- C4 [text](sources/charter.md) No one on the island harms an animal.
- C5 [text](sources/charter.md) Every episode ends with the keeper writing in the tide book.

Not set: how many episodes there are and who the keeper's family are. The owner did not decide them; an amendment writes them.
